each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row))
    top_color = next(v for v in grid[0] if v != 0)
    bottom_color = next(v for v in grid[-1] if v != 0)
    top_cols = {j for j, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == top_color}
    bottom_cols = {j for j, v in enumerate(grid[-1]) if v == bottom_color}
    for j in top_cols & bottom_cols:
        for i in range(1, sep):
            out[i][j] = 4
    return out
'''
(base/'task-156bea25.py').write_text(code)
ns={}
